text:
EDM took 62 shot attempts to SEA's 38 and generated 4.0 expected goals to 1.71, and for most of the night that still was not enough to separate them. Philipp Grubauer saved 1.63 goals more than his 25 shots against deserved, and Bobby McMann's power-play goal at 9:06 of the second tied it at 1 after Owen Michaels had scored on a 4% chance early in the first.

The second period was the one stretch SEA won, out-chancing EDM 1.21 to 0.37 in expected goals. EDM had dominated the first at 1.59 to 0.14, and they went back to that form in the third, where they held a 2.04 to 0.36 edge. Devon Levi stopped 19 of 20 shots, and the one that beat him was the McMann power-play goal. EDM went 0 for 3 on their own power plays despite 1.08 expected goals there.

The breakthrough came late. Leon Draisaitl snapped one home at 17:33 of the third, set up by Connor McDavid and Ryan Shea, on a 16% chance. McDavid then scored at 18:55 off a Vasily Podkolzin pass, a 37% look, to make it 3-1. With McDavid on the ice, EDM had 2.64 expected goals for against 0.54 against. By the numbers EDM deserved to win 82% of the time, and in the end the score matched that.
